description: Géothermie profonde - territoire de développement is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Jura. Délimite les secteurs potentiels pour le développement de projets de géothermie profonde dans le canton du Jura. Les secteurs définis tiennent compte des stations de distribution électrique les plus appropriées du canton et des principaux bassins de population du canton, afin de se situer à proximité des consommateurs et des activités. Coverage: Kanton Jura. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Jura. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML, WMS, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support heat network planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
